description.value: Bosa Foods is a Vancouver institution with over 60 years of experience importing and distributing specialty Italian and Mediterranean foods, stocking more than 7,000 SKUs spanning olive oils, aged cheeses, cured meats, pasta, preserved vegetables, and seasonal delicacies. The Kootenay Street location includes an in-store cafe where cyclists can refuel with espresso and freshly made panini. It serves both retail walk-in customers and wholesale foodservice clients, making it one of the most thoroughly stocked Italian specialty stops in the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bosa Foods is a real, active specialty Italian and Mediterranean grocery store at 1465 Kootenay Street, Vancouver, BC V5K 4Y3, with a matching phone number (604-253-5578). The website explicitly mentions 'have a delicious homemade panini and espresso in our cafe,' confirming hot food on site, and lists over 7,000 SKUs across food categories including cheeses, meats, fish, fruit, pasta, rice, and oils, confirming broad grocery stock. No bike parking or water bottle refill is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the confirmed postal address is Vancouver, BC V5K 4Y3 (East Vancouver), which is flagged as a concern.
